{LEADING_LABEL}

Lead equity in everyday work

Whether you are exploring leadership, leading a team or shaping direction across the division, find learning and practical tools for the decisions and responsibilities in front of you.

Everything here is public, and anyone can use it. You can start anywhere and skip anything. {LEADING_PRIVACY_SENTENCE} How this works.

Start where you are

Leadership can begin before a formal role. Choose a starting point that fits your work; these are invitations, not assignments or assessments.

changes.before: The Equity Analysis Toolkit is required of all staff of the Minnesota Department of Human Services, regardless of status. Everything else here is voluntary.
changes.after: DHS requires staff to use the Equity Analysis Toolkit and complete assigned Toolkit training through the agency's learning platform. The course linked here supports that work; it does not document completion of the agency's required training.

changes.after: These suggested paths do not enroll you or report your progress to a supervisor. If you save progress, others using the same browser profile may be able to see it.
